mapKinds.label: World / fantasy overland
mapKinds.description: Continents, regions and local areas: forests, mountains, coasts. Includes the Limited and Expanded palettes, the Region detail generator and the Places icon pack (towns, castles, ruins…).

mapKinds.label: Space
mapKinds.description: Sector charts, star systems and planets: Space - Sector, Space - System and Space - Planet palettes, Star scatter, Orbits and Planet surface generators, planet generators, the space icon pack. Pick Space alone and nothing fantasy is installed.

region.title: Region
region.desc: This stretch of space up close, at the same scale as the regions next to it. Not for a single star system or planet.

location.title: Location
location.desc: A star system, planet or station in this hex, with its own map and size. Pick this for a system or a planet.

region.title: Region
region.desc: This hex up close. Same scale for every hex on this map, and it lines up with the regions next to it.

location.title: Location
location.desc: A separate place in this hex, like a town or dungeon, with its own size.
